description: Ministry of Women Child Affairs and Social Security -  Duties and Functions of the State Minister of Women and Child Affairs, and State Minister of Social  Securit
categorisation: This gazette notification names a specific individual (Pavithra Wanniarachchi) as the Minister of Women & Child Affairs and Social Security, and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities including specific duties, functions, departments, statutory institutions, and laws to be implemented for both the State Minister of Women and Child Affairs and the State Minister of Social Security. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it contains both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
